title: Walks2Maps: Learning Indoor Geometry from Crowdsourced Wi-Fi RTT and Motion Trajectories
abstract: arXiv:2611.28532v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Everyday smartphone walks offer a scalable source of indoor geometry, but their motion traces drift and their radio measurements are distorted by multipath. We present Walks2Maps, a physics-guided framework that reconstructs a shared metric map from Wi-Fi round-trip-time (RTT) and motion observations, without a floor plan, surveyed access-point (AP) coordinates, or position labels. Walks2Maps jointly estimates pedestrian trajectories, AP locations, and per-trajectory stride scales, then recovers the pathway layout from the reconstructed paths. Shared AP observations connect walks recorded in different local frames, while metric ranges constrain their relative geometry and scale. An asymmetric range loss accommodates multipath-induced excess delay. On 22 phone trajectories collected along 11 routes on an office floor with 30 APs, Walks2Maps achieves median AP and trajectory errors of 0.87 m and 0.89 m, respectively, and a walked-area F1 s

translated_title: Walks2Maps：从众包Wi-Fi RTT与运动轨迹中学习室内几何结构
translated_abstract: 日常的智能手机行走为室内几何信息提供了可扩展的数据来源，但其运动轨迹存在漂移问题，无线电测量也会受到多径效应的干扰。我们提出了Walks2Maps，一个物理引导的框架，能够从Wi-Fi往返时间（RTT）和运动观测数据中重建共享的度量地图，而无需平面图、经勘测的接入点（AP）坐标或位置标签。Walks2Maps联合估计行人轨迹、AP位置以及每条轨迹的步幅比例，然后从重建的路径中恢复通道布局。共享的AP观测将记录在不同局部坐标系中的行走轨迹连接起来，而度量距离则约束了它们之间的相对几何关系和尺度。非对称距离损失用于适应多径效应引起的过量延迟。在一栋办公楼的一层沿11条路线收集的22条手机轨迹上（该楼层部署了30个AP），Walks2Maps实现了AP位置和轨迹的中位数误差分别为0.87米和0.89米，以及行走区域的F1分数……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: Walks2Maps是一个物理引导的框架，仅利用众包的Wi-Fi RTT和运动轨迹数据，无需平面图或位置标签，即可联合估计行人轨迹和AP位置并重建室内度量地图，误差小于1米。
en_tdlr: Walks2Maps is a physics-guided framework that reconstructs indoor metric maps without floor plans or position labels by jointly estimating pedestrian trajectories, AP locations, and stride scales from crowdsourced Wi-Fi RTT and motion data, achieving sub-meter accuracy.
